name: VBCI
protection: Aluminium hull with titanium/steel add-on armour panels, protected to roughly 14.5 mm frontally. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R can damage optics and exposed systems; 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate sides on the lighter variants; any launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Tall boxy 8x8 with evenly spaced axles (2 front, 2 rear groups)
Small one-man turret offset to the left behind the driver
Rear ramp door, bolted add-on armour tiles on sides
Large external stowage bins and smoke dischargers on turret
